blocks.orig: If you are searching for a special experience in the untamed wilderness of the Serengeti, look no further than the Bush Rover Migration Camp! Set in a prime location to witness the Great Migration up close in Kogatende from mid-July to late October, this seasonal camp offers six Land Rovers turned into brilliantly designed luxury suites. A spiral staircase leads you to your bedroom, placed on a platform above the iconic safari vehicle, featuring a double bed with a mosquito net, a sofa, a dressing area, and a furnished terrace. Just below, you will find a complete bathroom with a shower bath and a flush toilet in the passenger seat.
blocks.html: Looking for something special in the wild heart of the Serengeti? Then the Bush Rover Migration Camp is the place for you! This seasonal camp in Kogatende is perfectly placed to see the Great Migration up close from mid-July to late October, and it consists of six Land Rovers converted into cleverly designed luxury suites. You climb a spiral staircase to your bedroom on a platform above the iconic safari vehicle, with a double bed and mosquito net, a sofa, a dressing area and a furnished terrace. Right underneath is a full bathroom, with a shower bath and a flush toilet in the passenger seat.

blocks.orig: At sunrise, you will have the privilege to be the first to admire the herds of wildebeest and zebra crossing the Mara River from your terrace, and the many animals wandering around the campsite. And since being in the wilderness doesn’t mean sacrificing comfort, the camp is solar-powered so you can take a nice hot shower after your safari and enjoy sumptuous meals at the lounge and dining tent. To round off your day in style, gather around the campfire with a delicious drink and reminisce about all the wonderful things you saw. A one-of-a-kind adventure awaits you at Bush Rover Migration Camp!
blocks.html: When the sun comes up, you get the privilege of being the first to watch the herds of wildebeest and zebra cross the Mara River from your terrace, along with the many animals roaming around the camp. Being in the wilderness doesn’t mean giving up comfort: the camp runs on solar power, so after your safari you can enjoy a hot shower and lavish meals in the lounge and dining tent. To end the day in style, join the others around the campfire with a tasty drink and look back on all the wonderful things you have seen. At Bush Rover Migration Camp, a truly unique adventure is waiting for you!
